case_summary: A new PHP-based variant of the Interlock RAT is observed, leveraging a FileFix delivery mechanism to deploy both Node.js and PHP variants in a widespread campaign.

tools_used.purpose: Memory analysis to detect malware artifacts
Log file analysis for C2 communications and lateral movement indicators
Signature-based detection of malware and IoCs
